entries.source: This small orc has a malicious and greedy look in its eyes. Its veins pulse with new life and it moves with surprising speed. Though not fully developed you can still see the muscles forming on its long limbs, leading to clawed fingers and toes.
entries.target: 这只小兽人的眼里透露着恶毒和贪婪。它有着旺盛的活力并能以惊人的速度移动。虽然还没完全长大，但是你仍能看到它修长四肢上正在成形的肌肉，末端连着带爪的手指和脚趾。

entries.source:
This giant, bloated form towers above you. Mucus and slime ooze from every orifice, dripping onto the cavern floor. Orc children fight over the right to feed from her distended teats whilst small babies are regularly emerge from folds of flesh. The sight and the smell make you retch.
Here stands a tremendous form almost the size of a dragon. Bloated skin rises in thick folds, seeping viscous slime from its wide pores. Hundreds of hanging teats feed a small army of squabbling, fighting young orcs - only the toughest of them are able to gain the precious nutrients to grow stronger, the weaker ones left to wither on the mouldy floor. At the top of this towering hulk is a shrivelled head coated in long tangled hair. Dazed eyes peer out with a mixture of sadness and pain, but as they fix on you they turn to anger, the creature's face contorted with the fierce desire to protect its young.
entries.target:
这个巨大臃肿的身影耸立在你面前。黏液从它身上的每个孔洞渗出，滴落在洞穴的地面上。兽人幼崽们争抢着吸奶的权利，婴儿从它的肉褶中出生，眼前的景象和气味令人作呕。
站在你面前的是一只跟龙差不多体型的怪物。浮肿的皮肤隆起成厚厚的褶皱，粗大的毛孔渗出粘稠的液体。上百个垂挂的乳头喂养着一群争吵打斗的年轻兽人——只有最强壮的才能获得宝贵的营养变得更强，弱小的只能在发霉的地面上枯萎。在这只庞然大物的顶端是一颗枯萎的头颅，覆着一头蓬乱纠结的长发。茫然的眼神中混合着悲伤与痛苦，但当它们锁定你时，便转为愤怒，这张脸因护崽的强烈渴望而扭曲。

entries.source: #PURPLE#As the orc greatmother falls you realize you have dealt a crippling blow to the orcs.
entries.target: #PURPLE#当巨型兽人母体倒下时，你意识到你对兽人部落造成了致命的打击。

entries.source:
Epoch's Curve has served the Wardens for generations and was passed from Warden to Warden for many years before being lost.
According to legend it was made from the first ash sapling to sprout after the Spellblaze and carries powers of both time and renewal.
entries.target:
在亚伯契之弧失踪前，它已经世世代代服务于时空守卫，在时空守卫之间辗转相传多年。
根据传说，它是用魔法大爆炸后第一棵抽芽的白蜡树苗制成，同时拥有时间与新生的力量。

entries.source: Rak'shor, Grand Necromancer of the Pride
entries.target: 部落死灵大法师拉克·肖

entries.source: An old orc, wearing black robes. He commands his undead armies to destroy you.
entries.target: 一只穿着黑色长袍的年老兽人。他命令不死大军攻击你。

entries.source: and raised as a malformed servant
entries.target: 并将其复活为一个畸形的仆从

entries.source: This gigantic mass of flesh and stone moves slowly, the ground rumbling with each step it takes. Its body seems to constantly pulsate and reform. Massive stones at the end of each limb form massive blunt weapons.
entries.target: 这个由血肉与岩石构成的巨大躯体行动缓慢，每走一步都使大地为之震颤。它的身体看起来在不断地颤动和重塑。每条肢体末端的巨石构成了强大的钝器。

entries.source: A massive, shifting, ethereal form floats in the air around an orb of frozen blood.  The air around it condenses into freezing pools on the floor beneath it.
entries.target: 一个巨大的、变幻不定的灵体漂浮在半空，环绕着一颗冰封的血球。它周围的空气凝结成它脚下地板上的一滩滩寒冰。

entries.source: A towering creature, made from the bones of countless bodies. An aura of flame billows from within its chest.
entries.target: 像铁塔一样的生物，由数不清的骨头构成。它的胸前缠绕着一圈烈焰。

entries.source: The robes of this ancient vampire billow with intense winds. Bolts of lightning arc along its body. In its hand it holds a bow, electricity streaking across it.
entries.target: 这只远古吸血鬼的长袍在强风中鼓荡翻涌。闪电在他的周身环绕。他手里握着一把长弓，电弧在这把弓上流转。

entries.source: Intense Arcane energy whirls in the air around this ethereal form.
entries.target: 强烈的奥术能量在这个灵体周围的空气中旋转翻涌。
远行传送门：至远东大陆

entries.source:
A farportal is a way to travel incredible distances in the blink of an eye. They usually require an external item to use. You have no idea if it is even two-way.
This one seems to go to the Far East, a continent of which only rumours are known...
entries.target:
远行传送门能让人眨眼间跨越难以想象的距离。它们通常需要借助外部物品才能使用。你不知道这道门是否为双向的。
这道门似乎通向远东大陆，一块传说中的大陆……

entries.source: #VIOLET#You enter the swirling portal and in the blink of an eye you set foot on an unfamiliar cave, with no trace of the portal...
entries.target: #VIOLET#你进入了传送漩涡，一眨眼功夫便来到一个陌生的洞穴，此间已不见传送门的踪迹……

entries.source: "AN EDICT TO ALL CITIZENS OF THE IRON THRONE. LONG MAY OUR EMPIRE ENDURE"
entries.target: “致钢铁王座全体市民的布告。愿帝国长存。”

entries.source: A huge and muscular orc of unknown breed. He looks both menacing and cunning...
entries.target: 一只种类不明、肌肉发达的巨大兽人。他看起来既危险又狡猾……

entries.source: They say that after it has been confirmed orcs still inhabited Reknor, they found a mighty demon there.
entries.target: 据说在确认兽人仍居住在瑞库纳之后，他们在那里发现了一个强大的恶魔。

entries.source: When last you saw it, this cavern was littered with the corpses of orcs that you had slain. Now many, many more corpses carpet the floor, all charred and reeking of sulfur. An orange glow dimly illuminates the far reaches of the cavern to the east.
entries.target: 你上次过来时，这个洞穴里满是你杀死的兽人尸体。现在，更多的尸体铺在了地上，尽皆焦黑，散发着刺鼻的硫磺味。昏暗的橙色光芒隐约照亮了洞穴东面的深处。
最后希望的传令官哈诺

entries.source: This is one of the heralds of Last Hope. He seems to be looking for you.
entries.target: 他是最后希望传令官中的一员。他似乎找你有事。

entries.source: #LIGHT_RED#You hear a death cry. '%s I have a messag... ARG!'
entries.target: #LIGHT_RED#你听到了一阵临死的惨叫。“%s 我有消息要告诉你……啊……！”

entries.source: A terrible demon of decay and atrophy, drawn to the energy of the farportal. A beast of blight!
entries.target: 一只缠绕着枯萎和衰竭的可怕恶魔，他被远行传送门的能量吸引而来。这只瘟神！

entries.source: A careful examination of the demon's body turns up a Blood-Runed Athame and a Resonating Diamond, both covered in soot and gore but otherwise in good condition.
entries.target: 仔细检查恶魔的尸体，你发现了一把血符仪式匕首和一块共鸣钻石。两者都沾满烟尘和血污，但除此之外仍完好无损。

entries.source: open the seal and read the message
You cannot bring yourself to drop the %s
An athame, covered in blood runes. It radiates power.
entries.target: 一把刻满血色符文的仪式匕首，散发着强大的能量。

entries.source: A journal of the profits history of the Iron Throne dwarves.
entries.target: 有关钢铁王座矮人的盈利历史的记录。

entries.source: A trade ledger of the Iron Throne dwarves.
entries.target: 钢铁王座矮人贸易账本。

entries.source: Iron Throne Reknor expedition, last words
entries.target: 钢铁王座瑞库纳远征军的遗言

entries.source: Last words of a dwarven expedition to secure Reknor.
entries.target: 保卫瑞库纳的矮人探险队的最后记录。
瑞库纳·失落的矮人王国

entries.source: The Iron Council (Dwarven empire main city)
entries.target: 钢铁议会（矮人帝国的主城）

entries.source: A huge orc blocks your way to the Iron Council. You must pass.
entries.target: 一只巨大的兽人挡住了你通往钢铁议会的去路。你必须通过。

entries.source: , who ate their brains still warm,
Norgan and you are the sole survivors of the Reknor expedition; your duty is to make sure the news makes it back to the Iron Council.
entries.target: 诺尔甘和你是瑞库纳探险队仅存的幸存者；你的职责是确保消息传回钢铁议会。

entries.source: A small but sharp axe, with a handle made of polished bone.  The blade has chopped through the skulls of many, and has been stained a deep crimson.
entries.target: 一把小巧而锋利的斧头，斧柄由打磨过的骨头制成。这把斧头劈开过无数头骨，已被染成了深红色。

entries.source: This tall elf rushes at you, wielding both her greatsword and magical spells.
entries.target: 这位高大的精灵冲向你，挥舞着她的大剑，同时施放法术。
